← Ritmexa

Privacy by design.

Local media processing

Ritmexa processes selected photos, videos and audio in your browser. The current release does not upload selected editing media to a Ritmexa media processing server.

Video soundtrack extraction

If you select a saved video as the soundtrack source, Ritmexa attempts to prepare its embedded audio locally on your device.

Local preferences

The app may store lightweight preferences such as the selected language in browser storage.

Hosting

The application is delivered through GitHub Pages. Normal hosting request logs may apply to page requests, while selected editing media remains in the local editing workflow.
